items.title: Public Preview: Zone redundancy for Azure SQL Managed Instance Next-gen General Purpose
items.description:
You can now benefit from enhanced resilience with the public preview of zone redundancy for Azure SQL Managed Instance Next-gen General Purpose. This update helps you improve business continuity by automatically distributing your compute and data across availability zones, reducing the risk of downtime from localized failures. You gain greater reliability with up to 99.995% uptime without changing your application architecture, while maintaining the cost efficiency and flexibility of the General Purpose tier. With built-in high availability, you can confidently run mission-critical workloads and meet stricter uptime requirements with less operational effort. 

Learn more.

items.title: Generally Available: Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents on Microsoft Marketplace
items.description:
This release adds Microsoft Marketplace as a new discovery and procurement channel for Dragon Copilot AI apps and agents. Dragon Copilot customers in the United States can now discover, evaluate and purchase Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents through Microsoft Marketplace.

Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents enhance clinical workflows using advanced AI for documentation guidance, information surfacing, and task automation. These solutions help physicians in creating, summarizing, searching, automating, and analyzing data—helping improve efficiency, clinician wellbeing, patient experience, and care delivery. Dragon Copilot is part of Microsoft for Healthcare and is built on a modern architecture with enhanced security.

Purchasing through Microsoft Marketplace removes the need to onboard a new vendor or navigate separate procurement processes. Customers can acquire Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents through a streamlined purchase experience with consolidated billing through Microsoft. 

Learn more.

items.title: Public Preview: Azure Linux on WSL
items.description:
Azure Linux on WSL is now available in Public Preview (Beta).  Extending Azure Linux to the developer workstation means that teams can now:
  • Validate behavior using production-aligned configurations
  • Reproduce issues more reliably
  • Reduce time spent debugging cross-environment differences

With WSL support, teams can now use one Microsoft-supported Linux foundation across development, testing, and production. Now you can use familiar tools such as VS Code and Git locally, then deploy to Azure targets including virtual machines, AKS, and containers.

Learn more: 

  • Read the blog 
  • Overview of Azure Linux on WSL
